WorkspaceSwitcher.label: Workspace
WorkspaceSwitcher.createDescription: A workspace holds its own companies, contacts, and deals.
WorkspaceSwitcher.createFailed: Could not create the workspace. Try again.

Onboarding.title: Create your workspace
Onboarding.subtitle: A workspace holds your companies, contacts, and deals. Name yours to get started.
Onboarding.createFailed: Could not create the workspace. Try again.
Onboarding.joinNote: Joining an existing team? Ask a workspace admin to add you.
Onboarding.joinInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid invite link.

InviteAccept.heading: Join {workspace}
InviteAccept.invalidBody: This invitation has expired or has already been used.
InviteAccept.mismatchBody: This invitation was sent to {email}, but you're signed in as {current}.

InviteLinkAccept.heading: Join {workspace}
InviteLinkAccept.invalidBody: This invite link has expired, been revoked, or reached its usage limit.

WorkspaceSettings.title: Settings
WorkspaceSettings.subtitle: Manage who can access this workspace and what they can do.

WorkspaceSecurity.title: Passkeys
WorkspaceSecurity.subtitle: Passkeys let you sign in with your fingerprint, face, or a security key instead of a password. These are tied to your account, not this workspace.
WorkspaceSecurity.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.
WorkspaceSecurity.emptyBody: Add a passkey to sign in without a password using your device or a security key.
WorkspaceSecurity.renameDescription: Give this passkey a name you'll recognize, like the device it's on.
WorkspaceSecurity.addFailed: Couldn't add that passkey. Please try again.
WorkspaceSecurity.renameFailed: Couldn't rename that passkey. Please try again.
WorkspaceSecurity.removeFailed: Couldn't remove that passkey. Please try again.

WorkspaceMembers.title: Members
WorkspaceMembers.subtitle: People with access to {workspace}.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteSubtitle: Send an invite link. They join after signing in with the invited email.
WorkspaceMembers.memberInvited: Invitation sent — they'll see it in their notifications.
WorkspaceMembers.linkSubtitle: Anyone with the link can join with the role you choose. No email required.
WorkspaceMembers.linkCreateFailed: Could not create the invite link.
WorkspaceMembers.linkRevokeFailed: Could not revoke the invite link.
WorkspaceMembers.domainsSubtitle: Restrict invite links to people whose email matches one of these domains.
WorkspaceMembers.domainsEmpty: No domain restrictions. Anyone with an invite link can join, regardless of their email.

WorkspaceRoles.title: Roles
WorkspaceRoles.subtitle: Define custom roles with exactly the permissions a teammate needs.
WorkspaceRoles.noAccess: Only workspace owners can manage roles.
WorkspaceRoles.builtInSubtitle: Standard access levels. These can't be edited.
WorkspaceRoles.createDescription: Pick a name and the exact actions this role can take.
WorkspaceRoles.noPermissionsHint: Select at least the actions this role should allow.

WorkspaceRules.title: Rules & automation
WorkspaceRules.subtitle: Run actions automatically when records change or on a schedule.
WorkspaceRules.emptyBody: Create a rule to automate follow-up tasks, tags, and notifications.
WorkspaceRules.noAccess: Only members with rule access can manage automation.
WorkspaceRules.createDescription: Choose what triggers the rule and what it does.
WorkspaceRules.ruleNamePlaceholder: e.g. Follow up on won deals
WorkspaceRules.conditionRequired: A scheduled rule needs at least one condition
WorkspaceRules.actionTitleRequired: Add a title for each action
WorkspaceRules.actionTagRequired: Choose a tag for the tag action

WorkspaceCustomFields.noAccess: Only workspace admins can manage custom fields.

dialog.description: Define a field your records can carry.
dialog.keyInvalid: Enter a name that starts with a letter.
dialog.requiredHint: Must be filled before a record can be saved.
dialog.classificationHint: Flag fields that hold sensitive personal information.
dialog.classificationSpecialCareHint: Special care-required personal information (要配慮個人情報) may only be collected with the person's consent under the APPI.
dialog.specialCareConfirmBody: "{field}" will be treated as special care-required personal information (要配慮個人情報). Only collect it where you have obtained the person's consent, as required by the APPI.

WorkspaceMembership.pendingSubtitle: Workspaces you've been invited to. Accept to join.
WorkspaceMembership.leaveSubtitle: Leave {workspace} and lose access to its data.
WorkspaceMembership.leaveConfirmBody: You'll lose access to this workspace. Your assigned tasks become unassigned and deals you own lose their owner.

WorkspaceNotifications.title: Notifications
WorkspaceNotifications.subtitle: Choose how you're notified. These settings apply to you, not the whole workspace. Email needs a configured SMTP server (Settings → Email).
WorkspaceNotifications.taskDescription: When a task you're assigned is due or overdue.
WorkspaceNotifications.dealDescription: When a deal you own or collaborate on is closing soon or overdue.
WorkspaceNotifications.relationshipDescription: When a contact on one of your open deals goes quiet.
WorkspaceNotifications.mentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in a note.
WorkspaceNotifications.taskMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in a task.
WorkspaceNotifications.activityMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in an activity.
WorkspaceNotifications.introductionMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in an introduction.
WorkspaceNotifications.dealMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in a deal's close reason.
WorkspaceNotifications.loadFailed: Your notification preferences couldn't be loaded.
WorkspaceNotifications.saveFailed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.

WorkspaceEmail.title: Email
WorkspaceEmail.subtitle: Send this workspace's invites from your own SMTP server. Without a custom server, mail uses the instance default.
WorkspaceEmail.enableDescription: When off, this workspace sends through the instance default sender.
WorkspaceEmail.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the stored password. Stored encrypted; never shown.
WorkspaceEmail.saveFailed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
WorkspaceEmail.testSent: Test email sent. Check your inbox.
WorkspaceEmail.testFailed: The test email couldn't be sent.
WorkspaceEmail.loadFailed: Your email settings couldn't be loaded.

WorkspaceSso.title: Single sign-on
WorkspaceSso.subtitle: Let this organization's members sign in through your identity provider. Connex supports OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0.
WorkspaceSso.enableDescription: Turn on IdP login for members whose email domain is routed here.
WorkspaceSso.enforceDescription: Block password and passkey sign-in for this organization's members — they must use the IdP.
WorkspaceSso.jitWorkspaceHint: New members are added to this workspace on first sign-in.
WorkspaceSso.oidcIssuerHint: The IdP's OpenID discovery URL. Connex reads its endpoints automatically.
WorkspaceSso.oidcClientSecretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
WorkspaceSso.samlMetadataHint: Paste the IdP metadata, or provide the entity ID, sign-on URL, and certificate below.
WorkspaceSso.samlSpCertHint: Give this certificate to your IdP so it can verify Connex's signed requests. Generated automatically when you save.
WorkspaceSso.domainsHint: One domain per line. Members with these email domains are routed to this IdP.
WorkspaceSso.saveFailed: Your single sign-on settings couldn't be saved.
WorkspaceSso.loadFailed: Your single sign-on settings couldn't be loaded.
WorkspaceSso.noAccess: You need the Manage SSO permission to view this.
